title: The Unbelievable Bali Deal | Floating Breakfast, Five-Star Stays &  Vintage Car Tours
highlights: Experience the best of Bali with luxe stays, vintage rides, thrilling adventures, serene beaches, and rich cultural moments — all in one unforgettable escape.
Strike poses with a vintage Volkswagen at Sari Timbul amid lush rice terraces—a picture-perfect photoshoot blending nostalgia and Bali charm.
Feel the thrill on a 90-minute Temple Run–style ATV ride through Bali’s lush jungles, complete with scenic trails, splashes of mud, and tasty snacks.
Discover Pandawa Beach, renowned for its dramatic white cliffs, turquoise waters, and peaceful atmosphere—a hidden gem for capturing picture-perfect moments.
Witness the mesmerizing Kecak Fire Dance, where rhythmic chants, blazing flames, and stunning movements bring Bali’s legendary Ramayana tale to life under the open sky.
overview:
About the Tour:
﻿Your Bali journey begins with a warm welcome — a refreshing mocktail, a relaxing foot massage, and a beautifully decorated room that instantly sets the mood for a tropical escape. Wake up to a dreamy floating breakfast by your private pool before heading out to explore the heart of Bali in a vintage Volkswagen. Swing above lush jungles, chase the cascading Tegenungan Waterfall, and stroll through the serene Tegallalang Rice Terraces and Tirta Empul Temple, with a private photoshoot capturing every perfect moment. Feel the rush on an exhilarating ATV jungle ride, then unwind in luxury with ocean views and an infinity pool that mirrors the sky. Discover the beauty of Pandawa Beach, the spiritual aura of Uluwatu Temple, and the fiery spectacle of the Kecak Dance. End your adventure sailing across turquoise waters to Nusa Penida, where dramatic cliffs, hidden lagoons, and peaceful coves await — the perfect blend of romance, thrill, and island magic.

know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.

Where your itinerary mentions “local lunch,” it refers to an authentic Balinese meal featuring traditional flavors and dishes. Indian food will not be served during these local lunch experiences unless specifically mentioned.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to the stunning island of Bali! Upon arrival, enjoy a comfortable transfer to your hotel. Once there, check in to a beautifully decorated room that sets the tone for your tropical getaway. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, where you can explore the ancient charm of Goa Gajah with its intricate stone carvings, visit the vibrant Bali Bird Park to meet hundreds of exotic species, or dive into fun at Waterbom Bali, Southeast Asia’s top waterpark packed with thrilling slides.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Explore Bali’s most iconic gems on a unique vintage Volkswagen car tour. First, get driven to soar above lush jungles on the Bali Swing, soaking in panoramic views. Next, capture postcard-perfect shots at the stunning Tegenungan Waterfall, and experience spiritual serenity at Tirta Empul Temple, famed for its sacred spring pools. Also, enjoy a 1-hour professional photoshoot at Sari Timbul before wandering through the picturesque Tegallalang Rice Terrace, soaking in Bali's timeless charm.

items.desc: 1 X Vintage Volkswagen will be Provided

items.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul Temple - Bali Swing + Tegenungan Waterfall + Tirta Empul + Sari Timbul (Photoshoot) + Tegallang Rice Terrace Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen

days.title: ATV Ride Experience | Transfer to Kuta |  Visit to Finns Beach Club
days.desc: After check-out, embark on a thrilling ATV adventure, conquering Bali’s rugged trails, lush rice fields, and dense jungle paths—an experience straight out of Temple Run! Next, enjoy a scenic journey to Kuta, known for its golden beaches, bustling markets, and vibrant nightlife. Once in Kuta, check in to your hotel and relax by its infinity pool. Later, get driven to the lively Finns Beach Club, where infinity pools, tropical views, and upbeat vibes create the perfect island escape.

items.title: ATV Adventure in Bali - Double Sharing
Beachside Bliss at Finns Beach Club

days.title: South Bali Tour with Pandawa Beach
days.desc: Discover the charm of South Bali as you begin your day at Pandawa Beach, famed for its turquoise waters and stunning limestone cliffs—perfect for postcard photos. Continue to the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on a cliff edge overlooking the ocean. As the sun dips below, witness the enchanting Kecak Fire Dance, a powerful retelling of the Ramayana. Later, in the evening, get driven to Kuta Market, exploring colorful stalls, local crafts, and Bali’s vibrant night buzz.

items.title: Day Trip to Uluwatu Temple - Pandawa Beach + Uluwatu Temple Tour With Kecak Fire Dance + Kuta Market

days.title: Full Day Nusa Penida West Tour with Paluang Cliff
days.desc: Start your morning with a scenic drive to Sanur Port & board a speedboat to Nusa Penida, home to Bali’s most stunning coastal views. Once there, board your transfer to discover the iconic Kelingking Beach, known for its T-Rex–shaped cliff & sweeping ocean views. Marvel at the crystal-clear natural infinity pool of Angel’s Billabong & capture the raw beauty of Broken Bay with its dramatic sea arch. Continue to Paluang Cliff for amazing views of Kelingking before ending your day at Crystal Bay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and board your transfer to the airport for your return flight. As you bid farewell to Bali, carry with you memories of golden beaches, thrilling adventures, serene temples, and breathtaking sunsets — a perfect ending to your unforgettable island escape.
